message.content:
Step 1: Identify the track where the 2013 Liqui Moly Bathurst 12 Hour was staged. According to the source [2013 Liqui Moly Bathurst 12 Hour], the event was staged at the Mount Panorama Circuit.
Step 2: Find the length of the Mount Panorama Circuit. According to the source [Mount Panorama Circuit], the track is 6.213 km long.

Final answer: 6.213 km
